keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «노라가 지도를 따라간다(하는 일)» 와 «진짜 보물은 가족이다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the action (Nora follows the map) and the lesson (the real treasure is family). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: She follows the map and digs under a big rock.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

sum.pre: in Grandpa’s attic. She follows it and digs under a big
. It says the real treasure is family.

words: Nora finds an old map in Grandpa's attic.
a room under the roof of a house
Nora finds an old map in Grandpa's attic.
a picture that shows where places are
She follows the map past the old tree and over the little bridge.
a road that goes over water

to make a hole in the ground
Inside, there are old family photos and a note.

opts: She sees a big red X on the map.
She finds gold in the attic.
evs: There is a big red X on it.
She follows the map past the old tree and over the little bridge.
Inside, there are old family photos and a note.
why: «There is a big red X on it.» 지도의 빨간 X 표시는 보물이 있는 곳이에요. 그래서 «보물이다!» 하고 외쳐요.
There is a big red X on the map. An X on a map shows where treasure is.

qs.q: "Clunk! It is a box!" What is "Clunk"?
qs.qko: «Clunk! It is a box!» 에서 «Clunk» 는 무엇일까요?
opts: the sound of hitting something hard
evs: She digs and digs under a big rock.
The note says, "The real treasure is family. Love, Grandpa."
why: «She digs and digs under a big rock.» 땅을 파다가 단단한 상자에 «쿵» 하고 부딪힌 소리예요.
Nora digs and hits something hard. "Clunk" is that sound.

qs.q: What does Grandpa want Nora to learn?
qs.qko: 할아버지는 노라에게 무엇을 알려 주고 싶었나요?
evs: Inside, there are old family photos and a note.
The note says, "The real treasure is family. Love, Grandpa."
There is a big red X on it.
why: 상자 안에는 가족사진과 쪽지가 있고(«Inside, there are old family photos and a note.»), 쪽지에 «진짜 보물은 가족»이라고 적혀 있어요(«The note says, ...»). 두 문장을 이어야 할아버지의 마음을 알 수 있어요.
The box has family photos and a note, and the note says the real treasure is family. You need both sentences.

ends: Nora and Grandpa look at the old family photos together.
노라와 할아버지가 오래된 가족사진을 함께 본다.
Nora makes a treasure map for her little brother.
노라가 남동생을 위해 보물 지도를 만든다.

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «내 생각 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own idea and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because he is smiling)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because he is smiling)
write.src: “I think <u>Grandpa loves Nora</u> because <u>he leaves her a note</u>.”

img.cover: In a dusty attic full of old wooden trunks, a girl with a long brown braid in a red cap, a yellow jacket and green boots holds up a crinkly old paper map with a big red mark and shouts happily, as warm sunlight shines through a small round window.

scenes.1: Near an old twisty tree and a little wooden bridge over a stream, a girl with a long brown braid in a red cap, a yellow jacket and green boots digs with a small shovel under a big gray rock, and the corner of an old wooden box peeks out of the dirt.
scenes.2: Sitting on the grass beside a big gray rock, a girl with a long brown braid in a red cap, a yellow jacket and green boots smiles warmly as she holds old family photos from an open wooden box, with a folded paper note on her lap.

alt.1: Nora digs under a big rock and finds a box.
